note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors; nominations were received on Tuesday 17 May 1955 and Co. Londonderry polled on Thursday 2 June 1955. There were contests in two of the twenty-one divisions, Portstewart Rural and Hervey Hill; 'of the nineteen candidates returned unopposed all but one are former members of the Council' (Londonderry Sentinel, 19 May 1955, p. 4). Mr. Robert N. Workman, the one new member, succeeds Rev. J. C. Williamson in the Garvagh division, who did not seek re-election. Returned unopposed.
